name: visitora.eu Analytics
author: visitora

sections.description:
visitora.eu Analytics is the official WordPress integration for visitora.eu, a privacy-friendly website analytics service hosted in the European Union.

The plugin prints your personal tracking snippet in the <head> of every page, so your reports fill in automatically — no theme edits and no “Insert Headers and Footers” workarounds that break on theme updates.

Why visitora.eu?

  • Cookieless. The snippet sets no cookies, reads no browser storage and creates no fingerprint, so there is nothing to consent to under the ePrivacy rules for analytics storage. No consent banner needed for the analytics itself.
  • EU hosted. All data is stored in the European Union. Raw IP addresses are never stored.
  • Lightweight. The script is under 3 kB, loads asynchronously and never blocks rendering.
  • Free for one website. Free plan includes 90 days of history and full aggregate reports; Pro adds company identification, realtime, five websites per account and email reports.

This plugin acts as an interface to the visitora.eu service. By installing the plugin and entering your Site ID, you consent to measurement by the visitora.eu service on your site. See the visitora.eu Terms of Use and Privacy Policy.

How it works

  1. Create your free account at visitora.eu with an email address on the domain your WordPress site runs on.
  2. Copy the Site ID (and beacon token) from the snippet shown in your visitora.eu dashboard under Account.
  3. Paste both into Settings → visitora.eu Analytics in your WordPress admin. Done — the first pageview appears in your dashboard immediately.

What gets measured

Pageviews, dwell time, referrer, campaign parameters (UTM), screen size and browser language — aggregated only. No personal data is collected and nothing follows visitors across websites.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/visitora directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress plugins screen directly.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress.
  3. Use Settings → visitora.eu Analytics to enter your Site ID and beacon token from your visitora.eu dashboard.
sections.faq:
Do I need a visitora.eu account?

Yes. The plugin connects your site to the visitora.eu service. Create a free account at visitora.eu — the Free plan covers one website and 90 days of history.

Do I need a cookie consent banner?

Not for the analytics itself. The snippet sets no cookies, reads no device storage and creates no fingerprint. Your privacy policy should still mention the measurement.

Does the plugin work with caching and minification plugins?

Yes. The snippet is a single external script tag; caching and minification plugins (WP Rocket, LiteSpeed Cache, Autoptimize, …) leave it working as usual.

Can I exclude my own visits?

Yes. Enable “Do not measure logged-in users” on the plugin’s settings page.

Where can I see my data?

In your visitora.eu dashboard — Overview, Engagement, realtime (Pro), companies (Pro), events, goals and funnels.

Can I show a credit link to visitora.eu?

Optionally. The plugin can print a small “Privacy-friendly analytics by visitora.eu” link in your site’s footer. It is off by default and only appears if you explicitly enable it on the settings page.
